notes.title: Update 0.95
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25993596/01ff3661fd004e97667e9469772641ea20bcbe1b.jpg[/img]
This update introduces new types of game fields, updating the interface,
and so the overall performance improvement and much more.

An additional significant improvement is the improved synchronization of the multiplayer.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25993596/cd1a2d7e205163d8b6351a58c15d26cc43347cc1.jpg[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25993596/a91b9d8e7a2440d8bad82ce96fd8651afe326fab.jpg[/img]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25993596/aa68f44960124eb135e5cd39963f5a95c6a3a735.jpg[/img]


[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1] 
[list]
[*]Game engine version update.
[*]In the "Capture flag" mode, a bug was fixed when the player could take the flag of his team.
[*]Interface has been updated.
[*]New color decorations of the map (the playing field) are added.
[*]Fixed global out-of-sync / crashes in multiplayer.
[*]Added buttons for social networks.
[*]Links now open in the overlay Steam.
[*]Now the player's nickname picks up with Steam.
[*]The name of the server in multiplayer is now by default not empty.
[*]Improved multiplayer stability.
[*]Improved optimization.
[*]Added return to the previous menu by pressing the ESCAPE button.
[*]Changed the design of the nickname in the game near the player tank.
[/list]

tags.bug: * In the "Capture flag" mode, a bug was fixed when the player could take the flag of his team.
* Fixed global out-of-sync / crashes in multiplayer.

* Links now open in the overlay Steam.
* Now the player's nickname picks up with Steam.
* The name of the server in multiplayer is now by default not empty.
* Added return to the previous menu by pressing the ESCAPE button.

tags.balance_change: * Changed the design of the nickname in the game near the player tank.
